body:
did you know: taylor wrote all of "fifteen" backwards from a single line about her best friend -- "abigail gave everything she had to a boy who changed his mind."

that line came first; the whole song got built around it. and because it was abigail's real heartbreak, taylor played her the finished song and asked before ever putting it out. abigail's answer: "if one girl can kind of learn from it or connect to a song like that, it's totally worth it."

recording it undid taylor anyway -- she's said she cried in the studio, because "the things that make me cry are when the people i love have gone through pain and i've seen it." and when they shot the video, abigail is in it. as herself.

some friendships get a whole song, and the friend gets asked first.
